About Attabad Lake

Attabad Lake was created in 2010 when a massive landslide dammed the Hunza river, drowning villages and a stretch of the Karakoram Highway. Today the 21‑km turquoise lake is one of the most photographed places in Pakistan, with boating, jet skis and cliffside resorts along the new highway.
